reuse_v08_settings.loss: three-class cross entropy; mean within case then across training cases; no class weighting; L2 same original coefficient
reuse_v08_settings.standardization: training groups only; no held labels or all-case class priors

order: Inspect B>S first; inspect C>B only as additional value. No result-based hyperparameter revision.
stable_meaning: Pre-fixed seeds must have consistent direction; inspect by-case nonmandatory CORE delivery, serious lost counterauthority and complete-answer evidence separately. One pooled score cannot prove stability.
interpretation: No case-use labels, historical verdicts or source-target final reasoning in model input features; unknown/unreviewed not negative. No legal correctness claim from labels alone.
necessary_interface_note: V08 S factory defaults to14 units. Future V09 runtime must use actual pool size, in new source version only; do not train a14-unit S against30-unit B/C. This is dimensional compatibility, not GNN architecture tuning.
material_vs_answer_gate: C ranking benefit alone is insufficient; only stable original-material delivery AND source-reviewed complete-answer gain justifies growing GNN.
